title.zh: 基础设施保护（受保护区）（第 2 号）命令 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Areas) (No. 2) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 8 February 2025.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected area and surrounding area

text.en:
2.—(1) The premises described in the second column of Part 1 of the Schedule are declared to be a protected area for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of Part 1 of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the protected area.
(2) The premises described in Part 2 of the Schedule are specified to be the surrounding area of the protected area for the purposes of sections 27 and 28 of the Act.
3. Revoke the Protected Areas (No. 7) Order 2011 (G.N. No. S 284/2011).
